SELECT p.id, p.payment_number, p.invoice_id, p.opportunity_id, p.contact_id, p.account_id,
  p.amount, p.amount_received, p.refunded_amount, p.method, p.status, p.reference,
  p.payment_date, p.due_date, p.notes, p.owner_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at,
  (p.status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'partially_paid') AND p.due_date IS NOT NULL AND p.due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS is_overdue,
  i.invoice_number,
  o.name AS deal_name,
  ct.first_name AS contact_first_name, ct.last_name AS contact_last_name,
  co.name AS account_name,
  u.name AS owner_name
FROM payments p
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.id = p.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = p.opportunity_id
LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON ct.id = p.contact_id
LEFT JOIN companies co ON co.id = p.account_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.owner_id
WHERE p.is_archived = false
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC;

  COALESCE(SUM(p.refunded_amount), 0) AS total_refunded,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'partially_paid')) AS outstanding_count,
